name: angular_spectrum_propagate
signature: angular_spectrum_propagate(field, dx, dy, wavelength, dz, include_carrier)
doc: Propagate a scalar field a distance ``dz`` in free space (paraxial).

name: Aperture
doc: Aperture element class. An aperture serves to crop the beam, and the total beam intensity is reduced dependent on the area of the beam and the area of aperture.

name: aperture_mask
doc: Apply a hard circular aperture to a field.

name: apply_phase
doc: Apply a scalar phase to a field as :math:`e^{i\chi}` in its domain.

name: apply_thin_lens_scaled
doc: Absorb a thin-lens focusing power into the scaled curvature state.

name: as_ndarray
doc: Return the raw ndarray behind a sea_eco ``Signal`` (passthrough for arrays).

name: axis_components
doc: Split a scalar-or-pair frame quantity into its (x, y) components.

name: bandlimited_disk
doc: Exactly alias-free sampling of the sharp disk :math:`\Theta(a - r)`.

name: beam_support_extents
doc: Per-axis half-widths of the beam's support on the ξ/η grid.

name: beam_support_radius
doc: Per-axis half-width of the beam's support on the ξ grid.

name: beam_widths
doc: RMS beam half-widths in x and y from a stack of covariance matrices.

name: boundary_window
doc: Absorbing-boundary window: 1 in the interior, radial cosine → 0 at the edge.

name: build_basic_column
doc: Assemble the default generic TEM column at realistic scales.

name: change_scaled_frame
signature: change_scaled_frame(U, dxi, deta, wavelength, s_old, R_old, R_new, s_new, safety)
doc: Re-express the same physical wave in a different scaled frame (Eq 5).

name: convert_to_rotating_reference_frame
doc: Rotate rays into the beam's rotating (Larmor) reference frame.

name: dipole_pair
doc: Build a dipole pair: two thin dipoles rotated 45° in the same plane.

name: Drift
doc: Drift element class for free-space propagation.

name: ellipse
signature: ellipse(t, xc, yc, a, b, theta)

name: emittance
doc: RMS emittance in x and y from a stack of covariance matrices.

name: factor_wave
signature: factor_wave(psi, dx, dy, wavelength, s, R)
doc: Factor an ordinary paraxial wave into the scaled representation (handoff Eq 55).

name: fitForCrossover
signature: fitForCrossover(section, r0, targets, modifiable, axis, prefer, ignoreSigns, filename)

name: focal_phase
signature: focal_phase(field, dx, dy, wavelength, power_x, power_y)
doc: Apply a (possibly astigmatic) thin focusing phase.

name: fourier_resample
doc: Band-limited (Fourier-domain) resampling of a 2D field.

name: gaussian_field
doc: Build a Gaussian amplitude field centered on the grid.

name: grid_of
doc: Normalize a transverse-grid description to ``(ny, nx, dy, dx)``.

name: join_axes
doc: Join per-axis frame components, collapsing to a scalar when equal.

name: kernel_phase
signature: kernel_phase(shape, dx, dy, wavelength, dz, include_carrier)
doc: Reciprocal-space phase of the paraxial free-space transfer function.

name: Lens
doc: Lens element class for round lenses / symmetric focusing. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ray_transfer_matrix_analysis#Thin_lens_example or Brown1983 page 105

name: linear_phase
signature: linear_phase(shape, dx, dy, wavelength, tilt_x, tilt_y)
doc: Real-space linear phase ramp (wavefront tilt / dipole steering).

name: make_covariance_signal
doc: Wrap a stack of per-plane covariance matrices as a calibrated sea_eco ``Signal``.

name: make_kernel_phase_signal
doc: Wrap a reciprocal-space propagator phase χ(f_x, f_y) as a space-tagged Signal.

name: make_rays_signalset
doc: Wrap traced rays and their intensity/rotation as a sea_eco ``SignalSet``.

name: make_scaled_wave_signalset
signature: make_scaled_wave_signalset(U, dxi, deta, wavelength, s, R, tau, z, tags, name)
doc: Wrap a stack of reduced fields and their frame state as a sea_eco ``SignalSet``.

name: make_scaled_wavefield_signal
signature: make_scaled_wavefield_signal(U, dxi, deta, wavelength, s, R, tau, z, z_cross, tag, name)
doc: Wrap a reduced field ``U(ξ, η)`` as a single-plane scaled-wavefield ``Signal``.

name: make_screen_phase_signal
doc: Wrap a real-space phase screen χ(x, y) as a space-tagged Signal.

name: make_wavefield_signal
signature: make_wavefield_signal(data, dx, dy, wavelength, z, name)
doc: Wrap a complex field array as a calibrated sea_eco wavefield ``Signal``.

name: measureAtZ
doc: Measure the outermost ray's state at an arbitrary z position.

name: Microscope
doc: Microscope class represents a whole microscope, and is comprised of multiple MicroscopeSections. propagation through a Microscope results in propagation through individual MicroscopeSections

name: MicroscopeSection
doc: MicroscopeSection class represents a portion of a microscope, and contains multiple Elements. propagation through a Section results in propagation through individual Elements.

name: min_representable_curvature
signature: min_representable_curvature(n, dxi, wavelength, s, safety, x_max)
doc: Smallest reference-curvature radius a scaled frame can absorb or release.

name: obj_fun
signature: obj_fun(variables, elems_ext, namesof, X0, Y0, A0, B0, E0)

name: phase_space_of
doc: Return the application domain of a phase produced by the factories above.

name: plane_wave
doc: Build a unit-amplitude plane wave (uniform field).

name: plot2D
signature: plot2D(r1, R, axis, filename, zpts, sections, xlims, ylims, title, plt_ax)

name: plot3D
signature: plot3D(r1, R, filename, elev, azi, roll)

name: plotit
signature: plotit(Z, X, Y, A, B, elems)

name: point_source
doc: Build a discrete point source (single lit pixel at the grid center).

name: propagate_free_scaled
signature: propagate_free_scaled(U, dxi, deta, wavelength, dz, s, R, s_min, absorb)
doc: Propagate the scaled field U through one free segment of length ``dz``.

name: propagate_free_scaled_hybrid
signature: propagate_free_scaled_hybrid(U, dxi, deta, wavelength, dz, s, R, z, z_cross, safety, s_min, absorb, crossover)
doc: Propagate one free segment with automatic frame switching at crossovers.

name: propagate_thick_lens_scaled
signature: propagate_thick_lens_scaled(U, dxi, deta, wavelength, dz, s, R, K, s_min, absorb, rotate)
doc: Propagate the scaled field through a thick lens body (quadratic medium).

name: propogate2D
signature: propogate2D(elems, X0, Y0, A0, B0, E0)

name: quadratic_phase
signature: quadratic_phase(shape, dx, dy, wavelength, power_x, power_y)
doc: Real-space quadratic (focusing) phase screen.

name: quadrupole_pair
doc: Build a quadrupole pair: two thin quadrupoles of opposite-sign strength.

name: read_scaled_wavefield
doc: Read ``(U, dxi, deta, wavelength, s, R, tau, z)`` from a scaled wavefield.

name: read_wavefield
doc: Read ``(data, dx, dy, wavelength, z)`` from a wavefield Signal or fallback.

name: reconstruct_physical_wave
signature: reconstruct_physical_wave(U, dxi, deta, wavelength, s, R, target_dx, target_shape)
doc: Reconstruct the ordinary paraxial wave from the scaled representation.

name: relativistic_wavelength
doc: Relativistic de Broglie wavelength of an electron at a given accelerating voltage.

name: rootControlSettingValue
signature: rootControlSettingValue(level, path, activeOnly, filename, settings, active, reload)

name: rotate_field
doc: Rotate a sampled complex field about the optical axis, band-limited-exactly.

name: round_lens
doc: Build a thick round lens specified by focal length.

name: scaled_delta_tau
doc: Scaled propagation increment Δτ for a linear-s free segment.

name: scaled_delta_tau_lens
doc: Scaled increment Δτ across a constant-``K`` quadratic-index segment.

name: scaled_frame_crossover
doc: Read the crossover marker of a scaled wavefield's flat frame, if any.

name: scaled_frame_tag
doc: Read the frame-event tag of a scaled wavefield plane, if any.

name: Source
doc: Source element class. Source element can be put in a MicroscopeSection and then propagating "through" the section will mean the starting rays r0 are generated by the Source (instead of requiring the user pass in starting rays)

name: strength_for_focal_length
doc: Solve the thick-lens strength ``K`` that yields focal length ``f``.

name: tilt_phase
signature: tilt_phase(field, dx, dy, wavelength, tilt_x, tilt_y)
doc: Apply a linear phase ramp that tilts the wavefront (dipole steering).

name: transverse_coordinates
doc: Centered real-space coordinate grids for a wavefield.
